item.title: iconic math -- james algebra
item.description: iconic math is something weird and beautiful. in this post we look at what i think is called the arithmetic interpretation of james algebra [Iconic Arithmetic I, Iconic Arithmetic III], a particular interpretation of a particular form of iconic math. an expression of james algebra is formed by well-bracketed strings with three kinds of brackets – angle, round and square ()[]<>. further, we may use letters to represent variables a, b, c, …, e.
